newsitem.title: USA: Quantum rises on better-than-expected net.
newsitem.headline: Quantum rises on better-than-expected net.

text.p: Quantum Corp shares rose 9.8 percent Wednesday after the computer disk-drive maker reported fiscal third-quarter earnings on Tuesday that were far better than Wall Street expected.
Shares of Quantum, the second-biggest disk drive company, rose 3-1/4 to 36-3/8 on Nasdaq trading of 11.1 million shares, making the stock the second most active in U.S. markets.

After the market closed Tuesday, Quantum, based in Milpitas, Calif., said it had net income of $52.4 million, or $0.71 a share, for the quarter ended Dec. 29, compared with a loss of $2.48 million, or $0.05 a share, in the same quarter a year ago.
Analysts expected Quantum to earn $0.52 a share, according to a recent survey by First Call.
Quantum said strong sales along almost all its product lines produced the higher-than-expected profit.

Even though CEO Michael Brown said Tuesday that Quantum's fourth-quarter revenue will likely be flat compared with the third quarter, at least two investment firms upgraded their rating on Quantum's stock rating Wednesday. The analysts cited record shipments of disk drives for their boost.
